guangzhou-2014.notes: The XCPCIO scoreboard copy (source 2) holds only the first 32 team rows; the rest are empty rows a script fills, so a recapture with all teams rendered would help. The HDU pages (sources 5-15) do not name the Guangzhou regional, only contest 558 / 'STD Contest'; the match rests on the problem titles. Figures of 1002 and 1010 were not captured.
